signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Positive GEX ($1.14B) pins SPY below the $7375 call wall, creating a structural floor. Options flow confirms this with a 0.469 PC ratio and $3.2B in call premium, heavily skewed to deep ITM stock replacement. The Tension regime (66.5% CPCV accuracy) dictates a bullish bias with LOW-MEDIUM confidence. CAG indicates a wide bear-deluded gap, providing a contrarian edge against fear-driven headlines. Next-day historical accuracy (86%) further validates the bullish continuation thesis. Falling DXY (97.86) supports equity risk-on. The causal chain flows from GEX pinning -> options flow confirmation -> regime-specific strategy -> contrarian edge -> directional bullish call.
